north_star: 持续提升 RCL 作为可执行现实语义中间语言/现实事务演算的通用性、可表达性、可执行性、可验证性与现实鲁棒性；候选现实不得绕过证据、权限、版本、4R 与现实验证边界。

observations.signal: The new Perception Observe direct-lowering seam synthesizes Emergence rules inside the same user-visible rule namespace. A user rule named like the deterministic synthetic rule can therefore be silently shadowed after lowering because synthetic rules are appended and directive resolution is name-based.
Perception direct lowering still lacks C Native VM execution parity and domain-receipt parity evidence.
Whole-language native self-host closure remains bounded by Stage-0 host ownership.

ranked_candidates.problem: prevent direct-lowered synthetic perception rules from shadowing pre-existing user rules while retaining deterministic lowering and explicit evidence of any allocated rename
evidence: reserve all existing rule identities before synthesis
deterministically probe a collision-free synthetic identity without changing user rules or directives
surface collision avoidance in lowering diagnostics and summary

ranked_candidates.problem: execute the bounded perception lowering through canonical RBC and the C Native VM and prove semantic state-root parity
evidence: requires a full native execution environment rather than only the bounded transform harness

ranked_candidates.problem: remove remaining Stage-0 host ownership from whole-language self-host closure

mode_reason: A narrow correctness defect sits directly inside the newly introduced native-lowering seam and can change the meaning of existing user rules. Close the identity-integrity prerequisite before spending a larger reality-validation budget on C Native VM parity.
behavioral_change: existing user rule names are reserved before synthetic perception rules are allocated
a colliding synthetic rule receives the first deterministic free suffix instead of shadowing the user rule
existing user directives continue to resolve to the original rule
collision avoidance is explicit through RCL_FOUNDATION_DIRECT_LOWERING_RULE_NAME_COLLISION_AVOIDED diagnostics

adapter_contract.method: exact updated lowering module loaded under the existing foundation-direct-bytecode adapter contract with injected compile stubs; colliding user rule remained intact and the lowered Observe directive targeted the deterministic collision-free synthetic rule

ci_policy: Every branch commit carries [skip ci] [skip actions]. Do not actively consume GitHub Actions; verify the branch head remains workflow-free before PR and verify the PR head remains workflow-free before merge.
truth_boundary: This cycle closes synthetic-rule identity shadowing inside the bounded Perception direct-lowering seam. It does not claim C Native VM parity, Foundation domain-receipt parity, all-domain native lowering, provider-bridge removal, or repository-wide regression coverage.
